title: Interphase hand-off: play-build-without-sync spec and its 4 Steps go to mitosis
context: Interphase's feature pathway ran autonomously for option B. It produced docs/specs/play-build-without-sync.md with its decisions, record and items files: 4 Steps (sync-availability, android-sync-split, settings-hide-sync, changelog-1-0-1), 10 criteria (7.9 and 7.10 unproven, since they need Play Console and a real phone with sync on) and 18 assumptions. The first spec review found six issues, all confirmed against the code. The draft named :app:testReleaseUnitTest, which AGP 9 does not create here. The 7.3 test could read stale JUnit results. The startup wiring in main was untested. The draft named Delete journal as the threat, when the real path is engine start calling rescheduleForNetworkRule on every Android launch. It also had a needless rail option, and left unrecorded that every Android build without -P fieldNotesSelfUpdate=true loses sync. All six were fixed, and a second review confirmed each one closed.
options: Build the revised spec and Steps with mitosis from main at 7a8fbce7
Build the first draft as written
Reopen interphase for another review round
option_reasons: The six confirmed findings are fixed. The second review approved it, and check_spec, check_items and check_record --complete all exit 0. The plan-only pass (plan e76ebcbc49ce) is clean: 4 Lanes, 1 MSP.
Its 7.3 test named a Gradle task that does not exist, so the gate could never pass. Its review bar also pointed reviewers at a path no Play copy reaches.
The second review found no new issue, so another round would add time without changing what gets built.
outcome: Build the revised spec.
